plain_translation: The scene is looking for a node that is not there, or its name is spelled differently.
checklist_fixes: Check the node path is correct: use the Scene tree dock to verify names and nesting.
Use $NodeName or %UniqueName , unique names need the "Unique" checkbox.
Make sure the node exists in the current scene , it might be in a different scene.
If instancing dynamically, wait for _ready() before accessing child nodes.
problem_html: Godot says "Node not found" when you try to get a node. The scene loads but crashes on a get_node() call.
prevention_html: Use unique node names (%) for frequently accessed nodes. Avoid deep paths like ../../UI/Panel/Label.
keywords: node not found get_node path invalid null reference Node not found: ../NodeName scene tree null instance

plain_translation: The signal name does not match, or the function was never connected to it.
checklist_fixes: Check the signal name is spelled correctly in both emit_signal() and connect() .
In the Node dock → Signals tab, verify the connection was actually made.
Use signal_name.connect(callable) , make sure the Callable is valid.
The emitting node must exist in the scene tree , signals don't work on freed nodes.
problem_html: You emit a signal but the connected function never runs. Or Godot says "Can't emit non-existent signal".
prevention_html: Define signals with signal my_signal at the top of the script. Use the editor's Signals tab to connect , it auto-generates correct code.
keywords: signal not connected emitted never fires callable connect

plain_translation: The two objects are not set up to collide, so they pass through each other.
checklist_fixes: Both nodes need collision shapes , a Sprite alone has no collision.
Check CollisionObject2D layers and masks , matching layers = can collide.
StaticBody2D for floors/walls, RigidBody2D for physics objects, CharacterBody2D for players.
For Area2D, use body_entered signal and make sure monitoring is on.
problem_html: Objects fall through each other. Collision detection doesn't trigger. RigidBodies ignore the floor.
prevention_html: Set up collision layers early. Layer 1 = world, Layer 2 = player, Layer 3 = enemies , then mask them logically.
keywords: physics not working collision detection rigidbody areas overlap

plain_translation: The scene file has moved or its path is wrong, so Godot cannot load it.
checklist_fixes: Check the scene file (.tscn) exists at the correct path , files moved in Explorer break references.
Use preload("res://path/to/scene.tscn") with exact paths from the FileSystem dock.
Run "Reimport" on the FileSystem dock , some resources need reimporting after moves.
Verify the scene's root node type is valid (e.g. not a missing custom class).
problem_html: Godot shows an error when loading a scene. "Invalid scene" or "Can't load resource".
prevention_html: Always move files from within Godot's FileSystem dock, never from Windows Explorer or Finder , that breaks internal references.
keywords: scene not loading load error resource missing invalid scene
